chapter: Left out of the jazz books; Tatum, Handy and family
title: Maybe not colorful enough: no habits, no famous romances
summary: Willard jokes he never wore a checkered hat, took drugs or got arrested, and Collins says he and Billie Holiday were once close.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
